items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-12-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Lazy Daddy, uh, would play there and, and you were there... [INTERVIEWEE] That was a lot of money then. Yeah.

ctx.x: Uh, and, and, talked about Saturday, February 17th. There was no year, Jim. Looked quite old. 9.30 p.m. to 5 a.m. They had Don Albert and his pals from 9.30 p.m. to 2.30 a.m. And then the Palm Grove orchestra, 2.30 to 5 a.m. featuring Lazy Daddy at piano.
That was the same, that was in Carpers Christy Texas. Uh-huh. That had to be in, in 1931, 1932.
